Data (`plugin::magic-editor-x.suggestion`, table `magic_editor_suggestions`, hidden from the Content Manager and the Content-Type Builder, no Content API route, index `(entry_id, field_name, content_type)`): `contentType`, `entryId`, `entryLocale` (null without i18n), `fieldName` (the field identity of `access.checkField(...).fieldName`; never a positional path), `blockId` (`/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/`: the block changed or deleted, or the inserted block's new id), `op` (`update`|`insert`|`delete`), `afterBlockId` (inserts: the block it goes after, null = at the start; may be another open insert's block), `proposed` (`{ id, type, data, tunes? }`, null for deletes; normalised, sanitised with the field's sanitiser and inline tags of the field preset and the `rawHtml` policy, then checked with `checkPreset` without the whole-document rules `TOO_MANY_BLOCKS`/`TOO_MANY_CHARACTERS`; at most 64 KiB canonical JSON), `baseHash` (`shared/suggestions.mjs` `blockHash` of the block when it was suggested; null for inserts), `note` (plain text, comment rules, max 1000), `status` (`open`|`accepted`|`rejected`), `authorId` + `authorName`, `decidedAt`, `decidedById` + `decidedByName` (snapshots, cleared when the admin user is deleted; ids are never returned).

`blockHash`: cyrb53 (53 bit) of canonical JSON of `type`, `data` without unset leaves (`false`, `null`, `''`) and the non-default tunes (`diffTunes({}, tunes)`; the editor writes `alignmentTune: left`, `textVariant: ''`, `indentTune: 0` on every block, stored content has none). The admin hashes blocks normalised with `prepareEditorValue`.

"Outdated" is derived in the editor, never stored: `suggestionState(suggestion, current)` against the live content (shared room plus unsaved edits) is `open`, `outdated` (the block's hash differs from `baseHash`; inserts: the anchor is gone), `applied` (the content already equals the proposal; inserts: the id exists) or `missing` (update/delete of a block that is gone: reject only). A stored state would go stale with every live edit.

Routes (prefix `/magic-editor-x`, all with `admin::isAuthenticatedAdmin` + `admin::hasPermissions`; every handler checks Content Manager read on the document, locale and field with `services/access.js` `checkField` and answers 404 otherwise, also for suggestion ids of other documents; handlers log nothing):

| Method | Path                      | Actions                                   | Handler                | Input                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | Output                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ------ | ------------------------- | ----------------------------------------- | ---------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| GET    | `/suggestions`            | access (+ create or review, handler: 403) | `suggestions.list`     | `?uid&documentId&locale&field&fieldKey&status` (strict; `status` `open` default or `all`)                                                                                                                                           | `{ data: [suggestion], meta: { counts: { open, accepted, rejected }, canCreate, canReview, fieldKey } }` oldest first; `canReview` also needs CM update; keyless positional field: empty, both false |
| POST   | `/suggestions`            | access, suggestions.create                | `suggestions.create`   | `{ uid, documentId, locale?, field, fieldKey?, note?, suggestions: [1..50 of { op: 'update', blockId, proposed, baseHash } \| { op: 'insert', blockId, afterBlockId, proposed } \| { op: 'delete', blockId, baseHash }] }` (strict) | 201 `{ data: [suggestion], meta: { created, updated } }`; an open suggestion of the caller for the same block and op is replaced                                                                     |
| POST   | `/suggestions/:id/accept` | access, suggestions.review                | `suggestions.accept`   | `{ outdated?: boolean }` (strict; recorded in the audit counts)                                                                                                                                                                     | `{ data: suggestion }` (status `accepted`, with `proposed`)                                                                                                                                          |
| POST   | `/suggestions/:id/reject` | access, suggestions.review                | `suggestions.reject`   | `{}`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | `{ data: suggestion }`                                                                                                                                                                               |
| DELETE | `/suggestions/:id`        | access, suggestions.create                | `suggestions.withdraw` |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | `{ data: { id } }`; author only, open only (the row is deleted)                                                                                                                                      |

Suggestion DTO: `{ id, op, blockId, afterBlockId, proposed, baseHash, note, status, author: { name, own, deleted }, decidedAt, decidedBy: { name }|null, createdAt, updatedAt }`. Errors: 400 strict validation, `INVALID_BLOCK`, `PRESET_VIOLATION` (`details.blockIds`, `details.violations[].code`), `SUGGESTION_TOO_LARGE`, `DUPLICATE_SUGGESTION`, `TOO_MANY_SUGGESTIONS` (500 open per field and locale); 403 accept/reject without CM update, withdraw of someone else's; 404 not readable or `suggestions.enabled: false`; 409 `FIELD_KEY_REQUIRED` (positional field without a stored key), `ALREADY_DECIDED` (accept, reject and withdraw are conditional updates on `status: 'open'`: one decision wins); 429 `suggestions.perMinute` requests per admin (counter `suggestions:<adminId>` in `magic_editor_x_counters`).

| Action                                      | uid in `registerMany` | Meaning                                                                                |
| ------------------------------------------- | --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `plugin::magic-editor-x.suggestions.create` | `suggestions.create`  | Suggest (CM read on the document and field is enough: reviewers suggest); withdraw own |
| `plugin::magic-editor-x.suggestions.review` | `suggestions.review`  | Accept and reject (also needs CM update on the document, locale and field)             |

`GET /config` adds `data.suggestions: { enabled }` and `permissions.suggestionsCreate`, `permissions.suggestionsReview`. Config: `suggestions.enabled` (default `true`; the UI only appears for admins with one of the two actions, which no role has after the upgrade), `suggestions.perMinute` (default 20). Audit events (ids and counts only): `suggestion.create` (`counts.suggestions|created|updated|updates|inserts|deletes`, up to 20 block ids), `suggestion.accept` (`counts.outdated` 0/1), `suggestion.reject`, `suggestion.withdraw` (`meta.suggestionId`, `meta.op`, the block id). Retention: `utils/comment-retention.js` also deletes the suggestions of deleted document locales and anonymises authors and deciders of deleted admin users.

Admin:

- Suggest mode (`SuggestEditor.jsx`) is a second, local Editor.js instance on a copy of what the field shows. The field's own editor is set read-only and hidden (`inert`) meanwhile and keeps receiving live changes; the copy has no form, room, server or undo connection of the field, so typing, paste, Markdown shortcuts, the table tool, undo (its own history), templates, find and replace, AI and footnotes can never write to the shared document or the form: the field's toolbar, panels and global shortcuts (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+F, Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+P, Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+G) are off in suggest mode, and the copy is built without AI, Media Library, uploads (a suggestion creates no assets before review) and the footnote dialog. Chosen over "read-only plus a per-block proposal editor" because editing several blocks, inserting and deleting stay the normal editor gestures, and over guarding every write path of the field's editor because one missed path would leak edits into the live room. "Send suggestions" diffs the copy against the base (`suggestionsFromDiff`: `diffDocuments` alignment by id then similarity; a block paired by similarity updates the base block; reorders are not suggested and are counted in the dialog) and creates one suggestion per changed, inserted or deleted block; the dialog shows the counts and takes an optional note. Leaving with unsent changes asks first (ConfirmDialog) and the browser warns on unload.
- Entry points: "Suggest changes" and "Suggestions (n open)" in the field's More menu; contextual only: "You cannot edit this field, but you can suggest changes" with a "Suggest changes" button under a field the admin cannot edit, and "n open suggestions · Review suggestions" under the field while any are open. No new toolbar icon.
- Review (`SuggestionsPanel.jsx`, `SuggestionMarkers.jsx`, `useSuggestions.js`): markers at the inline end of blocks with open suggestions (beside a comment marker; the holder gets a second marker column only while a block has both), the panel lists open suggestions in document order with the word diff against the block as it is now, author, time, note, state badge, Accept, Reject, Withdraw (own, ConfirmDialog) and Show block; Accept on an outdated suggestion asks first; "Accept all" (ConfirmDialog) accepts the suggestions in `open` state and leaves outdated ones. Accept first marks the suggestion accepted on the server (only one reviewer wins), then applies the server-sanitised proposed block through `replaceContent` (`applySuggestions`, inserts follow the chain of open inserts): one undo step, live collaborators see it, the form gets dirty and the normal save stores it. No version is created per accept ("Before suggestion"): undo covers it until the save, the save is versioned as usual, and "Accept all" of many suggestions would create many versions. Polling like comments (15 s, 8 s with the panel open, on focus and after own actions).

Editor.js limits met: `editor.save()` of a read-only instance did not return the content, so suggest mode starts from the content the field shows; Editor.js writes default tunes and unset data leaves on save (handled by `blockHash`); "/" pressed right after Enter, before Editor.js moved the caret into the new block (next tick), is typed as text instead of opening the toolbox; an active Editor.js Flipper (document capture keydown handler) takes the first Tab presses (three measured) in any dialog opened from an editor, also the field's own dialogs (keyboard shortcuts dialog), so the suggest editor closes its toolbars before the send dialog opens, which does not cover every case.

Strapi review workflows (decided: no stage hook in 2.4). Read in the installed 5.61.1 source: `@strapi/review-workflows/dist/server/index.js` registers services, routes, controllers and the Document Service middlewares only when `strapi.ee.features.isEnabled('review-workflows')` (license feature, `@strapi/core/dist/ee/index.js` `features.isEnabled = get(name) !== undefined` over `ee.licenseInfo.features`); otherwise only the `workflow`/`workflow-stage` content types load, so a Community Edition host has no stage attribute, no stage route and nothing to change. A stage change is `PUT /review-workflows/content-manager/(collection|single)-types/:model_uid/:id/stage` (`routes/review-workflows.js`, `enableFeatureMiddleware('review-workflows')`, `controllers/stages.js` `updateEntity`: stage transition permissions, then `services/stages.js` `updateEntity`), which writes `strapi.documents(model).update({ documentId, locale, data: { strapi_stage: { id } } })`; the review-workflows middleware `handleStageOnUpdate` (`services/document-service-middleware.js`) runs around it. A plugin could refuse it with a Document Service middleware that throws a `ValidationError` when `ctx.action === 'update'` and `ctx.params.data.strapi_stage` names a configured stage while the quality gate fails; deleting a stage moves entries with knex (`stages.updateEntitiesStage`) around the Document Service, which no middleware sees. None of this can be exercised end to end without an Enterprise/Growth license with the `review-workflows` feature, so no untested code ships. Review workflows also have their own "required stage for publishing" (`checkStageBeforePublish`). The Content Manager side panel with open suggestion and comment counts was left out: the counts are already in each field (markers, notice, menu) and a panel per edit view would add requests for every document type without a new decision for the editor.

Tests: `tests/suggestions.test.mjs` (hash, diff to suggestions, states, apply, markers, notes, routes and actions, fake-DB service and controller: sanitising, preset, strict input, RBAC, conditional decisions, rate limit, positional key, retention), `tests/integration/suggestions.test.mjs` (SQLite and PostgreSQL hosts).

## Configuration

Defaults and validation in `server/src/config/index.js` (the README has the table): `debug`, `rawHtml`, `sanitizeOnSave`, `encryptionKey`, `uploads.maxImageBytes`, `uploads.maxFileBytes`, `uploads.maxMediaBytes`, `uploads.allowPrivateOrigins`, `linkPreview.enabled`, `linkPreview.timeoutMs`, `api.autoParseJSON`, `ai.allowPrivateBaseUrl`, `ai.apiKey`, `ai.requestsPerMinute`, `ai.timeoutMs`, `ai.altText.allowPrivateOrigins`, `languageTool.allowPrivateBaseUrl`, `languageTool.requestsPerMinute`, `languageTool.timeoutMs`, `collaboration.enabled`, `collaboration.path`, `collaboration.allowedOrigins`, `collaboration.pollIntervalMs`, `collaboration.roomTtlMinutes`, `collaboration.maxMessageBytes`, `collaboration.snapshotIntervalMinutes`, `collaboration.tokenTtlSeconds`, `collaboration.maxConnectionsPerAdmin`, `collaboration.maxRoomsPerAdmin`, `collaboration.revalidateSeconds`, `collaboration.rateLimit.sessionsPerMinute`, `collaboration.rateLimit.updatesPer10s`, `collaboration.rateLimit.bytesPer10s`, `collaboration.compaction` (`enabled`, `idleSeconds`, `minBytes`, `ratio`, `checkIntervalSeconds`), `history.maxSnapshotsPerField`, `comments.enabled`, `comments.perMinute`, `comments.mentionsPerMinute`, `comments.notifications` (`email`, `emailPerHour`), `suggestions.enabled`, `suggestions.perMinute`, `links.urlPattern` (validated by `isValidLinkPattern`), `qualityChecks.externalLinks` (`enabled`, `timeoutMs`, `perMinute`, `allowPrivateOrigins`, `schedule`: `enabled`, `rule`, `tz`, `maxUrlsPerRun`, `perMinute`, `perHostConcurrency`), `audit.enabled`, `audit.retentionDays`. Environment: `MAGIC_EDITOR_X_ENCRYPTION_KEY`. Read config inside functions, never at module load. Arrays have empty defaults because Strapi merges config arrays by index.

## Editor toolbar and field tools (2.4)

The field toolbar stays short. Visible in the bar: Undo and Redo (not on read-only fields), the **More tools** menu (DS `Menu`, a text button), Full screen, a visible way back while a view-changing tool is on ("Back to editing", "Leave focus mode"), the save hint of a positional field without a saved key, then live collaboration presence/status and the counts. Every other tool of the field is one entry of the field tool registry and appears only in More tools, grouped **Review** (comments, version history, suggestions, quality checks), **Write** (suggest changes, AI for the whole field, grammar check, find and replace, insert template) and **View** (preview, focus mode, keyboard shortcuts). Block-level tools stay where the block is: Editor.js block tunes (incl. the AI tune), the selection bar for selected blocks, comment markers in the gutter.

Registry (`admin/src/editor/field-tools.mjs`, pure; rendered by `components/EditorField/FieldToolsMenu.jsx`; built in `EditorField` as `fieldTools`):

| Key          | Type                                                     | Meaning                                                                                                                                                |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `id`         | string, unique                                           | Stable name; item `data-testid="mex-tool-<id>"`, exit button `mex-tool-exit-<id>`                                                                      |
| `group`      | `'review' \| 'write' \| 'view'`                          | Menu section (order `TOOL_GROUPS`)                                                                                                                     |
| `label`      | string                                                   | Translated, plain language                                                                                                                             |
| `icon`       | node                                                     | Decorative start icon (`@strapi/icons`)                                                                                                                |
| `shortcut`   | string                                                   | `CMD+SHIFT+F` form (as in `ShortcutsDialog`); shown as `Ctrl+Shift+F`/`Cmd+Shift+F` and set as `aria-keyshortcuts`. The tool keeps its own key handler |
| `badge`      | `{ count, tone: 'primary'\|'warning'\|'danger', label }` | Count in the item (hidden at 0); `label` is the full accessible name with the count                                                                    |
| `pressed`    | boolean                                                  | The tool is a toggle (panel, preview, focus mode): `menuitemcheckbox` with `aria-checked` and a check mark                                             |
| `exitLabel`  | string                                                   | With `pressed`: label of the visible way-back button in the bar while the tool is on                                                                   |
| `visible`    | boolean (default true)                                   | False removes the entry (permission, config, field option, read-only). Hidden entries are still validated                                              |
| `disabled`   | boolean                                                  | Shown but not selectable                                                                                                                               |
| `order`      | number                                                   | Position inside the group; otherwise the given order                                                                                                   |
| `movesFocus` | boolean                                                  | The tool focuses its panel or dialog itself; the menu then does not return focus to its trigger                                                        |
| `onSelect`   | function                                                 | Runs the tool. It runs after the menu has closed and released focus (Radix traps focus in an open menu)                                                |

`groupFieldTools` throws on a missing or duplicate id, an unknown group or a missing `onSelect` (`tests/field-tools.test.mjs`).

How to add a field tool:

1. Build the panel or dialog as a self-contained component with one primary action, a close control and a helpful empty state. Panels render in a `PanelSlot` under the toolbar; dialogs use DS `Modal`.
2. Add one entry to `fieldTools` in `EditorField/index.jsx` (pick the group by what the editor wants to do: review, write or view). Set `visible` from config, RBAC and field options so the item only appears where it can work; new features are off by default.
3. On close, return focus with `focusToolsMenu()` (the More tools trigger), never to `<body>`.
4. A keyboard shortcut goes in the existing key handler of the field plus `shortcut` in the entry and a row in `ShortcutsDialog`.
5. Do not add icon buttons to `EditorToolbar.jsx`; the source test allows exactly undo, redo and full screen.

## Admin and i18n

- Build every screen with `@strapi/design-system` and the admin `Page`/`Layouts`; colours and spacing from theme tokens only (no hex, no `var(--colors-*)`; 1rem = 10px). Destructive actions use `ConfirmDialog`. No `window.confirm`, no `console.log`, no emoji.
- Translation keys live in four areas, `admin/src/translations/{common,editor,tools,settings}/{en,de,fr,es,pt}.json`, prefixed with the area (`editor.history.title`). Every key exists in all five locales; German uses formal "Sie". The `defaultMessage` in code equals the English text. `tests/admin-i18n.test.mjs` enforces parity, ICU validity and no orphans.
- Editor tools in `admin/src/editor/tools` keep the 1.x block names and data. Untrusted strings reach `innerHTML` only through `sanitizeInline`, `sanitizeTemplate` or `sanitizeSvg` from `admin/src/editor/sanitize.js`.

## Releases

Conventional commits (angular preset). A breaking change needs a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer; `!` alone is not counted by the commit analyzer. semantic-release publishes from `main`; the hand-written `## [Unreleased]` section of CHANGELOG.md is folded into the release notes by `scripts/release-unreleased.mjs`.
